top_signals.title: Trump and Xi Buy Time, But Solve Almost Nothing
top_signals.summary: There is much to be said on many issues between the U.S. and China, and it was -- in the many meetings that occurred between American and Chinese officials that took place as the two countries’ leaders said very little during Xi Jinping’s three-day visit to counterpart Donald Trump last week. However, having tapped several U.S. and European Union (EU) sources that were very close to the proceedings, OilPrice.com has put together the key points really thrashed out between the two sets of negotiation teams while Trump and Xi strolled…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Hydro One on Meeting Increased Electricity Demand
top_signals.summary: Harry Taylor, Executive Vice President, Chief Financial & Regulatory Officer, Hydro One, discusses the transmission investment required to meet rising electricity demands while balancing reliability, affordability and long-term capacity, with Bloomberg’s Naureen Malik at the 2026 Bloomberg Canadian Finance Conference. (Source: Bloomberg)
